args.script:
phone.open("Settings")
phone.wait(2500)

local nodes = phone.look()
phone.log("nodes=" .. #nodes)
if #nodes > 3 then phone.log("TREE-OK") else phone.log("TREE-EMPTY") end

local labelled = 0
for _, n in ipairs(nodes) do
  if n.text ~= "" then labelled = labelled + 1 end
end
phone.log("labelled=" .. labelled)

-- A toggle that is not there must be reported, never tapped on spec.
local ok, why = phone.ensure({ text = "no-such-toggle-here" }, true)
phone.log("missing-toggle=" .. tostring(ok) .. "/" .. why)

-- The sandbox holds: none of this is reachable from a script.
local sealed = true
for _, name in ipairs { "os", "io", "require", "load", "debug" } do
  if _G[name] ~= nil then sealed = false end
end
phone.log("sealed=" .. tostring(sealed))

return "script-ok"
